content_blocks.title: Apply the idea
content_blocks.text: Predict the output type and value, run a minimal SELECT expression, and test a NULL or boundary input. Write down the expected result before running the snippet. Compare actual output with the reference, then try one normal case and one edge case.

content_blocks.code: WITH scores AS (SELECT 'Ari' AS learner, 90 AS score UNION ALL SELECT 'Mina', 95 UNION ALL SELECT 'Dev', 90) SELECT learner, score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC, learner) AS row_num, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS score_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS dense_rank FROM scores ORDER BY score DESC, learner;
content_blocks.expected_output: Rows show a deterministic row number; Ari and Dev share rank 2 and dense rank 2 because their scores tie.
